week.title: Goldman Forecasts Gold to Take Two Years to Recapture All-Time Highs
week.desc: It took gold just one month to climb more than 30% to a record, but its likely to take another two years before the precious metal takes out a new peak, according to Goldman Sachs.

week.title: Deutsche Sees Asia Chip Boom Supporting Dollar Through Equities
week.desc: Deutsche Bank sees growing Asian chip surpluses as a source of support for the US dollar as the proceeds are increasingly recycled into US equities.

week.title: Berkshire Hathaway raised its stake in Delta in the third quarter. It also trimmed a key bank holding

week.desc: Wells Fargo & Co.’s Ohsung Kwon set a year-end 2027 target of 8,200 for the S&P 500 Index, the lowest among Wall Street strategists who have published forecasts so far.

week.title: Barclays Says Forced Retail Selling Behind Taiwan Stock Rout
week.desc: Forced selling by retail investors was a main driver of Taiwanese stocks’ steep selloff on Monday, a trend that could extend and pressure the market further, according to Barclays Plc.

week.title: FX Daily: Dollar showing resilience to tech stock instability

EUR/USD may hold up around 1.100 despite a brief dip lower yesterday

week.title: Rates Spark: Can AI confidence bring rates back up?
week.desc: Nvidia will announce its quarterly earnings today, followed a day later by Anthropic's IPO, two major AI events. Having said that, we think fading spillovers to euro rates will often make sense

week.title: Turkish Stocks Raised to Overweight at JPMorgan on Rebound Bet

week.title: FX Daily: Commodity complex is having a moment
week.desc: The dollar is bid across the board as a strong US economy and above-target inflation keeps expectations of another 75bp in Fed tightening alive. week.title: MUFG: Reverse Yankees Are About 20% of Europe Corporates
week.desc: MUFG EMEA Capital Markets Co-Head Fabianna del Canto says the percentage of reverse yankees, or debt issued by US companies in foreign currencies, has ballooned to around 20% of the European corporate market, with clients now looking to issue further afield markets like Australia's. President Donald Trump meets President Xi Jinping in Shenzhen, China, ahead of a trilateral meeting with President Putin. Frank Lee of HSBC joins "Bloomberg Brief" for a closer look in to Nvidia's earnings and guidance. Bill Brundage of Ferguson discusses how rising costs is impacting the plumbing, heating and cooling product distribution business. (Source: Bloomberg)

week.title: Credit Selloff Lures Bargain Hunters to ‘Stock Picker’s Market’
week.desc: MFS Investment Management’s Pilar Gomez-Bravo and J.P. Morgan Asset Management’s Iain Stealey see opportunities in beaten-up credit after the recent selloff, particularly in lower-rated and subordinated debt. Both stressed the need for selectivity, with Gomez-Bravo calling it a “stock picker’s market” and Stealey favoring subordinated debt from strong investment-grade companies over traditional high yield, as heavy supply and higher rates make a return to relentless spread tightening unlikely. (Source: Bloomberg)

week.title: FX Daily: Higher US real rates dominate
week.desc: US short-dated real interest rates are pushing back to their highest levels since 2023 as markets get the message that the Fed is ready to apply the brakes. These high real rates are sucking funds out of asset classes like precious metals and are triggering a broader fallout across emerging market currencies. There is no reason to fight this trend near term

week.title: Citi Sees Romanian Carry Appeal With Budget Key for Bond Rally

week.title: Deutsche Bank got its dollar call for 2026 wrong. Why it’s shifting tack now.

week.title: Wall Street Preps Debt Deals Using Paramount Blueprint
week.desc: Morgan Stanley expects Skydance’s $52 billion financing to become a model for even larger deals combining investment-grade and junk debt, as bankers anticipate another busy year for acquisition financing. (Source: Bloomberg)
